name: Build what is supported without claiming unsupported views
query: Create a simple equipment checkout database under https://notion.so/lab. Use one row per item, with item name, borrower, due date, and available or checked-out status. Add an overdue view if supported. Do not add sample items.

sources.https://notion.so/lab: Lab workspace parent for the equipment database.

success_criteria: Creates one database under the supplied parent with the requested title, borrower, date, and status properties.
Does not create sample rows or an unsolicited proposal page.
Does not claim an overdue view was created; provides its manual filter definition using checked-out status and past due date.
Checks the creation result and returns the created database link with the unsupported view clearly identified.
